draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Willy Guggenheim (offlane→jungle).

coaching.headline: Two favored lanes sat out the fights that mattered; we won three fights and converted zero, and lost every Fangtooth.
coaching.team: Willy Guggenheim played Greystone offlane, one of five off a bottom-two lane; the offlane and midlane still read ours all game (Greystone over Bayle, The Fey over Renna), while the carry and jungle read theirs all game (Revenant under Gideon, Khaimera under Zarus). We conceded the first Fangtooth at 17 with nobody dead, a free pickup rather than a lost fight. We never took any of the match's three Fangtooths; the others fell at 23 and 29 -- all three went to them. We won three fights and cashed none of them into a tower or objective; they won six and converted two. Towers finished 2 to 10, and our objective damage finished at 0 against their 42,956. The Fey was repeatedly alive and ahead but missed the 18m game-defining fight. Both Greystone and The Fey were alive and ahead but absent from the 29.2 Fangtooth loss -- the fight that preceded the Core falling at 30.3.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: At 29.2, Greystone and The Fey were both alive and ahead in their lanes but absent from the Fangtooth fight, which we lost 2-3; they took the Fangtooth, and the Core fell at 30.3.
coaching.whatWorked: We outwarded them 42 to 24; Muriel alone placed 18 wards against the enemy support's 5, and we held zero deaths before minute 10 on support.

focus.title: No one built armor into Zarus's damage
focus.evidence: Zarus did 35k physical, the enemy's single biggest damage number, and zero of five of us itemized armor against it; Muriel and Greystone were separately flagged for no magic resist against a three-magical enemy comp.
focus.action: Send an armor item at whichever enemy is doing the most physical damage, and build the magic resist the comp telegraphs by the first full back.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Alacrity shield+AS → Consecrated Ground bubble → Reversal global save
ourKits.winCondition: keep the carry alive with global shields and enable their damage
ourKits.passive: abilities grant Sentinel to allies; on-hit bonus
ourKits.playAgainst: she has no damage threat — dive her carry through the shields or pick her first

ourKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
ourKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
ourKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
ourKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
ourKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs
